               <lb n="18.1b5"/><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3868">pa tshab</rs> byon nas | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5559">bod</rs> 'dir yang | thal 'gyur gyi lasogs? gsal bar byon | 
               dus phyir | kun mkhyen chos sku 'dir man chad du | rang stong dang gzhan stong gi bsrol gnyis byung | </seg></TEI>
